slice: Bind retained workflow evidence inputs to open file descriptors before reading.
finding: Path validation followed by later path-based reads left a time-of-check/time-of-use gap. A retained source could theoretically be replaced after validation but before parsing.

behavior: Open each retained input with O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW.
Reject symbolic links at open time.
Require each opened descriptor to reference a regular file.
Compare device and inode identities and reject duplicate or hard-linked source files.
Read JSON and command text from the already-open descriptors.
Close all descriptors on success and failure.
